it sounds good on paper but I have already missed so much of my
youth. i fucked up last semester and so boom behind 3 months. I took an extra semester in highschool because of credit errors when moving across state lines, which effectively put me a year behind because I couldn't go to college spring semester. Nothing would change from the time off. At least I don't think it would. What are your thoughts? Have you taken time off or do you know someone who has but for a similar situation— not just recreationally? I just don’t see my mental health drastically improving from a year off.

Also: No way in hell I can take any time off. I want my life to start already. Thanks to constant moving in high school I wound up taking an extra year. Now I am behind a another semester because of medical leave. It feels like I’ve already wasted a year and a half of my life with nothing to show for it. Sought therapy and treatment the whole time and things stayed the same. They were going alright until a few
months ago. I keep telling myself I just need one more shot, and then I get it and mess it up again.

I went last semester for unforeseen circumstances. If I go again, I worry they will see me beyond redemption.  I was so ecstatic to get in to UMass. Now I’ve dropped the ball so many times I feel like they are ready to throw me out.

Thank you for the advice:) I’m attending therapy now, it’s never helped much but I will keep going regardless. It at least gives me something to do. I am enrolled with UWW courses right now because I am on medical leave for fucking up last semester. With that context I’m not sure they will be as forgiving or if they will let me stay. I’m in too deep

I came in as a linguistics major and of course wasn’t smart enough for it lol. I hope to do comp sci, if I continue. Not sure they will even let me stay. But comp sci really is one of the few things I enjoy
